thailand.title: Flag of Thailand (Thong Trairong)

colors.note: Represents the nation and the blood shed for independence
Symbolizes Buddhism and purity of faith
Represents the monarchy; chosen to show solidarity with Allied powers in WWI

desc: - Five horizontal stripes in the pattern red–white–blue–white–red, with the blue centre stripe twice as wide
- The colours embody the national motto 'Nation–Religion–King'
trivia:
- The red represents the nation and blood of the Thai people
- The white represents Buddhism and the purity of the Thai people
- The blue represents the monarchy, which is deeply revered in Thai culture
